visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl with dark hair tied in two small pigtails stands on a checkered stone pavement with red and gray square tiles. She is wearing a white ruffled sleeveless sundress and small sandals with cartoon bear prints. She looks downward with a neutral expression. In the background, there is a traditional brick wall and a large green wooden double door. White text with a peach icon is overlaid at the top center. (2) The scene shifts to an older girl wearing a purple and white checkered top and wide beige trousers standing on a low wooden platform. She looks down at her feet and then smiles towards the camera. The background shows an outdoor patio area with people sitting at tables under large umbrellas. (3) The older girl raises her arms and cheers while smiling broadly. A wooden cart with wheels is partially visible in the background to the left. White subtitles appear at the bottom center. (4) Close-up shot of the toddler crouching near a wooden tray containing a plastic bottle wrapped in clear film. A man's hand reaches in to guide a wooden rod with a string. The texture of the weathered wood and the semi-opaque plastic film on the bottle are distinct. (5) The toddler holds a wooden rod with a string attached to the bottle, trying to lift it upright. She looks focused, then pouts as the bottle falls back down. The setting is the same paved outdoor area. (6) The toddler successfully uses the rod to hook the bottle's neck and stands it upright. She stands up and looks at the camera with a satisfied expression. (7) The two girls are standing together in front of the green doors, swaying and dancing. The older girl stands behind the toddler, holding her shoulders. They both look cheerful. (8) Indoors, the girls are at a traditional wooden divination counter. The older girl holds a large bamboo tube filled with wooden fortune sticks. Various people in casual clothing are standing nearby. (9) The older girl vigorously shakes the bamboo tube until a stick falls out. The toddler watches with curiosity. An adult woman's hands are visible assisting them with the process. (10) Outdoors again, an elderly man in a white traditional top and a dark hat is demonstrating a large wooden spinning top on a metal tray. A crowd of people is gathered around to watch. (11) The older girl is led by the hand by the elderly man towards the spinning top on the tray. She looks excited and surprised as the top spins rapidly. (12) The toddler is standing near a large watermelon sculpture that has a hole in it. She points at the hole and looks back at the camera. The older girl joins her, and they both touch the sculpture before waving goodbye.
